claim_text: A cognitive-support goal alone does not establish choline deficiency or demonstrate that choline supplementation improves cognition in otherwise healthy people; intake and indication require assessment.
health_goal_or_outcome: Avoid unsupported product claims and align recommendations with evidence and individual context.

population.other_context: People considering choline supplements for general cognitive support.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary or supplemental forms; verify exact formulation and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Choline fact sheet describes dietary sources, intake requirements and evidence context.
limitations: No dose or cognitive benefit can be inferred from a wellness goal.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
